verdict.rationale: Circle's docs state USDC/EURC are '100% backed' by cash/cash-equivalents and 'always redeemable 1:1' (circle-docs-27, circle-docs-28), but community evidence documents a concrete contradiction: during the SVB collapse, $3.3B of reserves were stuck at a failing bank and USDC depegged to $0.85, undermining the 'always redeemable' claim (circle-comm-1, circle-comm-4, circle-comm-3). No attestation reports (e.g., third-party audit cadence) or any yield/rewards program eligibility/regulatory caveats are documented anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: independent attestation report links/cadence, yield or rewards program terms and eligibility, regulatory caveats, and resolution/reconciliation of the reserve-composition claim post-SVB.
